verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Dataplex data lineage docs, which describe a visual map of where data comes from, where it travels and the transformations along the way. That covers part of the lineage half of the story, though it is a companion Dataplex service and is not shown to be column-level. Nothing in the pack documents audit logs of who ran which queries; IAM roles and query-plan diagnostics are adjacent features, and migration lineage applies to source databases rather than BigQuery. Missing for 10: audit logs recording who ran what, explicit column-level lineage, evidence that lineage is native to BigQuery rather than Dataplex, and independent corroboration.
